# Kiscord — Full API Signatures & Symbol Contracts (llms-full.txt)
> Comprehensive reference containing function signatures, parameter contracts, and schemas.

---

## 1. Core System API (`/js/core/`)

### `/js/core/state.js`
```typescript
export const state: {
    currentUser: { id: string; email: string; user_metadata?: any } | null;
    currentChannel: string;
    library: { movies: MediaItem[]; series: MediaItem[]; games: MediaItem[] };
    watchHistory: Record<string, { status: string; rating: number; reaction?: string }>;
    watchlist: Array<{ id: string; type: string; user_id: string }>;
    calendar: CalendarEvent[];
    timeline: TimelineEvent[];
    activeWorkout: ActiveWorkoutState | null;
    habits: HabitItem[];
    loveCoins: number;
    relationshipXP: number;
    settings: {
        theme?: string;
        sidebar?: {
            collapsedCategories?: string[];
            hiddenChannels?: string[];
            channelOrder?: string[];
        };
    };
    [key: string]: any;
};

export function saveStateToCache(): void;
export function loadStateFromCache(): Promise<boolean>;
export function initializeState(): Promise<void>;
export function awardLoveCoinsToCurrentUser(amount: number, reason?: string): Promise<void>;
```

### `/js/core/router.js`
```typescript
export const moduleMap: Record<string, () => Promise<any>>;
export const channelCategories: Array<{
    name: string;
    items: Array<{ id: string; name: string; icon: string; type: string; color: string; desc: string }>;
}>;

export function switchChannel(channelId: string, params?: any): Promise<void>;
export function renderChannels(): void;
export function toggleCategoryCollapse(categoryName: string): void;
export function collapseAllCategories(): void;
export function expandAllCategories(): void;

```

### `/js/core/ui.js`
```typescript
export function renderModal(options: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    content: string;
    actions?: string;
    onClose?: string;
}): string;

export function renderButton(options: {
    text: string;
    variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'success';
    onClick?: string;
    icon?: string;
    className?: string;
}): string;

export function renderInputGroup(options: {
    label: string;
    id: string;
    type?: string;
    value?: string | number;
    placeholder?: string;
    attr?: string;
}): string;
```

### `/js/core/utils.js`
```typescript
export function triggerHaptic(type?: 'light' | 'medium' | 'heavy' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'): void;
export function triggerConfetti(): void;
export function normalizeText(str: string): string;
export function getTodayKey(): string; // YYYY-MM-DD

```

---

## 3. SQL Database Schema & RLS

```sql
-- Profiles & Gamification
CREATE TABLE public.profiles (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    username TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    avatar_url TEXT,
    love_coins INT DEFAULT 50,
    relationship_xp INT DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Library & Media
CREATE TABLE public.library_content (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('movie', 'series', 'game')),
    cat TEXT,
    poster_path TEXT,
    rating FLOAT,
    runtime INT,
    trailer TEXT,
    magnet TEXT,
    gdrive TEXT,
    mood_tags TEXT[],
    is_frequent BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Watchlist & Mutual Likes
CREATE TABLE public.library_watchlist (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    media_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.library_content(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    added_by UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    type TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(media_id, added_by)
);

-- Reviews & Watch History
CREATE TABLE public.library_ratings (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    media_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.library_content(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('watching', 'seen', 'unseen')),
    rating INT CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5),
    reaction TEXT,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(media_id, user_id)
);

-- Gym Workouts & Sets
CREATE TABLE public.gym_workouts (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_seconds INT NOT NULL,
    volume_kg NUMERIC(10,2) DEFAULT 0,
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE public.gym_sets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    workout_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.gym_workouts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    exercise_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.gym_exercises(id),
    set_order INT NOT NULL,
    reps INT NOT NULL,
    weight_kg NUMERIC(6,2) NOT NULL,
    is_warmup BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Personal Finances
CREATE TABLE public.app_finances (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('income', 'expense')),
    category TEXT DEFAULT 'Ostatní',
    is_shared BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Tier Lists
CREATE TABLE public.tier_lists (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT DEFAULT 'general',
    data JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    is_duel BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
    created_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Tetris Leaderboards
CREATE TABLE public.tetris_scores (
    user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id),
    score INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
```
